stage: FDA/EMA approved (prostate cancer only); breast = prospective pilot/phase 2-size cohorts
breast_tnbc_evidence: Prospective PRISMA (68Ga-PSMA-11, progressive mTNBC): 50% had uptake >liver in most lesions; 67% of 106 FDG-avid target lesions >liver; 65% had >=1 lesion below liver (heterogeneous). Prospective 18F-PSMA-1007 vs FDG in mTNBC (n=20): FDG uptake generally higher; no patient met a lesional SUV threshold for PSMA-RLT. 68Ga-PSMA vs FDG in TNBC (n=42): distant-met SUVmax 6.0 vs 15.5 (FDG); 48% PSMA IHC+. Localisation: mainly tumour-associated neovasculature (74% of primaries, 100% of brain mets PSMA+ endothelium; no carcinoma-cell staining, n=106) and 60% PSMA+ endothelium, highest in TNBC (n=315); one IHC series also reports tumour-cell staining.
pmid_or_nct: PMID 41309999; PMID 41964062; PMID 36756767; PMID 24304465; PMID 29455299; PMID 29426963; NCT06586047 (piflufolastat, mTNBC, early phase 1, recruiting); NCT06059469 (PRISMA)
background_organs: Salivary + lacrimal glands, kidneys, bladder, small bowel, liver/spleen (18F-PSMA-1007 more hepatobiliary); ganglia
theranostic_partner: 177Lu-PSMA-617 FDA-approved for mCRPC; in breast cancer only a single-patient case report (PMID 29455299) and preclinical 177Lu-PSMA-I&T vascular targeting in TNBC xenografts (PMID 38378689)
notes: Vascular-predominant expression means uptake is perfusion/angiogenesis-linked and heterogeneous; PSMA-RLT feasibility in TNBC looks limited on current SUV data. No published breast data found for DCFPyL or rhPSMA-7.3 specifically.

stage: No ATB0,+-selective tracer in humans (FEMAET preclinical only). AMT = human pilot but not ATB0,+-specific
breast_tnbc_evidence: Dynamic AMT PET in stage II-IV breast cancer (n=9): tumour SUV 2.6-9.8, IDC highest (4.7-9.8); interpreted via LAT1/IDO/TPH1 IHC, not ATB0,+. Key mechanistic caveat: alpha-methyltryptophan is an ATB0,+ BLOCKER, not a transportable substrate; 1-methyltryptophan is a substrate (PMID 18522536). FEMAET imaged ATB0,+ in PC-3/NCI-H69 xenografts; negligible uptake in ATB0,+-negative MDA-MB-231 (TNBC line).
background_organs: AMT: UNVERIFIED (brain/pancreas reported in neuro literature; not checked here)
notes: Surprise: the commonly cited AMT tracer is not an ATB0,+ substrate, so AMT uptake cannot be read as SLC6A14 activity. No radiolabelled 1-MT human study found (UNVERIFIED).

breast_tnbc_evidence: Mechanism: FLT is transported by hENT1, hENT2, hCNT1 and hCNT3 (oocyte expression); hCNT1 had lowest Ki, then hCNT3; uptake in cancer cell lines was >=50% hENT1(NBMPR)-dependent (Paproski 2008). ACRIN 6688 (NAC breast, 90 recruited/51 primary analysis): %dSUVmax after cycle 1 only marginally associated with pCR (AUC 0.68). TNPET01 randomized phase 2 TNBC (n=22): both FLT and FDG repeatable; FDG chosen for part B because of image quality/availability.
background_organs: Bone marrow (high), liver (glucuronidation), urinary tract
notes: FLT is a proliferation (TK1) tracer, not a CNT3-specific probe; CNT3 is one of several entry routes. No CNT3-selective tracer found.

stage: First-in-human / phase 1 imaging substudies (not in breast)
breast_tnbc_evidence: No breast/TNBC PET data found. 89Zr-RG7356 in 13 pts with CD44+ solid tumours: dose-dependent target-mediated uptake in spleen, liver, marrow, lung, kidney; tumour uptake seen in all pts at >=450 mg pre-dose. 89Zr-U36 (CD44v6) in 20 HNSCC pts: detected all primaries, nodal sensitivity 72%.
background_organs: Spleen, liver, bone marrow, lung, kidney (target-mediated normal-tissue sink)
theranostic_partner: None current; 186Re-bivatuzumab RIT (CD44v6) historical phase 1 - UNVERIFIED in this session
notes: Ubiquitous normal/immune expression makes pan-CD44 a poor imaging target; isoform-specific (v6) agents less so but no breast data.

stage: Phase 3 (18F-FAPI-74 in pancreatic/GEJ cancer, 2025-26); not approved
breast_tnbc_evidence: Prospective 68Ga-FAPI vs FDG primary staging (n=50): primary-lesion SUVmax 13.3 vs 6.9; primary sensitivity 100% vs 92% (n.s.); management change 12%. TNBC subgroup of prospective trial (68Ga-FAPI-46 vs FDG, n=22): region detection 93% vs 93%; 3/12 restaging pts SUVmean>=5 (theranostic-eligible). 18F-FAPI vs FDG staging IIB-IIIC (n=38): higher nodal/distant lesion sensitivity. 68Ga-FAPI-04 NAC monitoring (n=66 incl. TNBC).
background_organs: Low liver/brain background; pitfalls: uterus/endometrium, normal breast in some women, scars/wound healing, arthritis/degenerative joints, pancreas, salivary glands; renal/bladder excretion
theranostic_partner: 177Lu-FAP-2286 (LuMIERE NCT04939610) phase 1 done: 27 treated, RP2D 9.25 GBq; phase 2 ongoing (not breast-specific)
notes: Stromal (CAF) target, not tumour-cell; benign fibrosis/post-surgical uptake confounds residual-disease imaging. Short tumour retention of FAPI-04/46 limits RLT.

stage: First-in-human / pilot and prospective translational cohorts (no phase 3)
breast_tnbc_evidence: 68Ga-FZ-NR-1 vs FDG in recurrent/metastatic TNBC (n=40): more lesions detected, sensitivity 98.1% vs 93.5%, specificity 68.6% vs 27.5%, higher TBR (FDG SUVmax higher); high intra-patient heterogeneity; high MTV/heterogeneity predicted shorter PFS/OS. FIH pilot in TNBC (n=9): IHC-confirmed. 68Ga-TDN1 FIH in breast (n=6). 68Ga-N188 in 16 cancer types (n=62): SUVmax correlated with membranous nectin-4. Dual FZ-NF-1 in TNBC (n=13) comparable to FDG with extra lesions.
background_organs: Kidneys/bladder (renal clearance); other organ uptake UNVERIFIED (see dosimetry PMID 41485193)
theranostic_partner: 225Ac-AKY-1189 (miniprotein) phase 1b NECTINIUM-2 (NCT07020117) with planned TNBC expansion cohort (web-sourced, not PubMed); 177Lu-FZ-NF-1 mice only; enfortumab vedotin (non-radioactive ADC) approved in urothelial cancer
notes: Strongest TNBC-specific diagnostic dataset among novel targets, but all from a small number of Chinese centres.

stage: Prospective investigator-initiated cohorts; one registry record lists phase 2/3 (NCT06851663)
breast_tnbc_evidence: 68Ga-MY6349 prospective breast (n=73): more malignant lesions (564 vs 436) and fewer false positives (2 vs 40) than FDG; SUVmax 5.9 vs 4.1; management change 12-20%; 3 TNBC on Trop2-ADC: early uptake change tracked response. Pan-cancer MY6349 (n=90): breast SUVmax 7.2 vs FDG 5.4; uptake correlated with IHC. 68Ga-NOTA-T4 HER2-negative (n=42): comparable to FDG; TNBC uptake lower after treatment. 18F-RESCA-RT4 (n=35 breast): uptake correlated with Trop2 IHC.
pmid_or_nct: PMID 42559486; PMID 39509246; PMID 41781717; PMID 42134979; PMID 39878898 (89Zr-sacituzumab, preclinical); NCT06715020; NCT07046455; NCT07046702
background_organs: UNVERIFIED in detail; renal/bladder excretion for peptide tracers; normal Trop2 in epithelia (e.g., salivary/oesophageal/skin) not checked here
theranostic_partner: No human TROP-2 radioligand therapy found (177Lu anti-TROP2 preclinical only); non-radioactive partners sacituzumab govitecan / sacituzumab tirumotecan (approved ADCs)
notes: Most ADC-relevant PET target for TNBC; 89Zr-sacituzumab itself is preclinical only.

breast_tnbc_evidence: No breast-specific published data found. FIH (n=6 dose escalation; melanoma/lung/HCC) and phase 2 iCorrelate (n=49 solid tumours on checkpoint blockade, 70 biopsies): tumour SUVmean/aorta correlated modestly with CD8 IHC (r=0.49; 0.71 in RCC); repeat on-treatment PET safe.
background_organs: Spleen, bone marrow, lymph nodes, liver (CD8-rich lymphoid tissue)
notes: Breast inclusion in these trials UNVERIFIED; tracer measures immune infiltrate, not tumour cells.

breast_tnbc_evidence: 89Zr-atezolizumab FIH (n=22 across bladder, NSCLC, TNBC; TNBC count not in abstract, reported elsewhere as ~4 - UNVERIFIED): heterogeneous tumour uptake; pretreatment PET correlated with response better than IHC/RNA. 89Zr-atezolizumab work-up in mTNBC (n=3): all had avid lesions but 2/3 biopsied avid lesions were PD-L1 IHC-negative. 18F-BMS-986192 and 68Ga-NOTA-WL12 human data are NSCLC only.
background_organs: Spleen, lymphoid tissue, liver, kidneys (small-protein tracers), inflammation sites
notes: PET-IHC discordance in TNBC is the main finding; antibody tracer needs 4-7 day imaging.

breast_tnbc_evidence: FTT kinetics in new breast cancer (n=30): tumour/muscle DVR correlated with PARP-1 protein (n=10). FTT response study: 24 untreated primaries (uptake not correlated with HRD score) + 10 metastatic HER2- on PARPi: baseline uptake (rho 0.74) and on-treatment change (rho -0.86) correlated with PFS. gBRCA neoadjuvant talazoparib (n=7): blocking on day-14 scan shows target engagement. 18F-ATD001 vs FDG in TNBC (n=37).
background_organs: Liver/hepatobiliary-gut excretion, spleen, bone marrow (marrow uptake linked to haematological toxicity)
theranostic_partner: No human PARP radioligand therapy found; 211At-/125I-PARPi (incl. [211At]talazoparib) preclinical
notes: Measures target expression/engagement, not HRD; small n.

breast_tnbc_evidence: Prospective locally advanced IDC/ILC (n=27): all primaries avid; avid axillary nodes in 20/21 path-positive; detected unsuspected extra-axillary nodes. Exploratory dynamic (n=12): malignant SUVmax 6.2 vs benign 1.3; highest in triple-negative and grade 3. Metastatic ILC (n=20): fluciclovine detection > standard imaging and > 68Ga-PSMA-11.
background_organs: Liver, pancreas, bone marrow, muscle (low brain/bladder early)
notes: Transport mainly via ASCT2/SNAT2 with LAT1 contribution (PMID 23647854); not single-gene specific.

breast_tnbc_evidence: Exploratory trial NSCLC (n=10) + breast (n=5): FSPG identified 3/5 breast primaries and only 30/73 (41%) FDG-avid breast lesions; tumour/blood-pool ratio significantly lower than FDG in breast. SUVmax correlated with xCT and CD44 IHC.
background_organs: Kidneys, pancreas (high); rapid blood clearance
notes: Weak breast performance in the only human breast data.

breast_tnbc_evidence: TNBC is typically FDG-avid: mean SUVmax 6.97 for TNBC vs 3.41 luminal A (n=308 tumours, 53 TNBC). Neoadjuvant: <42% SUVmax drop after 2 cycles -> residual tumour 100% and higher early relapse (n=20 TNBC); dSUVmax -72% (pCR) vs -42% (no pCR), regimen-dependent (n=78 TNBC); TNPET01 randomized phase 2 (n=22) chose FDG over FLT and early dSUV correlated with RCB.
background_organs: Brain, myocardium, urinary tract, brown fat, bowel, inflammation/infection, post-surgical change
notes: Benchmark comparator for every novel tracer above.

stage: FDA approved (2020, Cerianna) - approval fact from prior knowledge, not re-checked in this session
breast_tnbc_evidence: Negative control only: ER-negative/TNBC lesions expected FES-negative; no TNBC-specific study pulled.
background_organs: Liver (very high, hepatobiliary), gut, urinary tract; limits liver-met assessment
notes: Useful only to confirm absence of functional ER.

breast_tnbc_evidence: FIH in primary breast cancer (n=20; 22 tumours): tumour/normal ratio 2.6 PR+ vs 1.5 PR-. Phase 2 estradiol-challenge (n=43 ER+): post-challenge rise only in endocrine responders. Not relevant to TNBC except as negative control.
background_organs: Liver, gallbladder/biliary, gut (UNVERIFIED detail)
notes: ER+ disease tool.

breast_tnbc_evidence: ZEPHIR (89Zr-trastuzumab before T-DM1, HER2+ mBC, n=56): 29% HER2-PET-negative; heterogeneity predicted T-DM1 non-response. 68Ga-ABY-025 in HER2-low mBC (n=10): all had avid lesions; HER2-low confirmed in 8/10, 2 were IHC 0. Retrospective 89Zr-trastuzumab/pertuzumab (n=23): all prior 'false positives' were HER2-low on pathology.
background_organs: 89Zr-mAbs: blood pool, liver, spleen, bowel; ABY-025: kidneys, liver
theranostic_partner: No HER2 RLT in routine use; non-radioactive partner trastuzumab deruxtecan (approved for HER2-low/ultralow)
notes: Relevant to TNBC because ~1/3+ of TNBC are HER2-low; PET may visualise HER2-low but HER2-0 discrimination unproven.

stage: Phase 2 (non-breast: NEN, glioma, oral SCC, prostate)
breast_tnbc_evidence: FIH 64Cu-DOTA-AE105 (n=10: 4 prostate, 3 breast, 3 bladder): uptake in primaries/nodes paralleled uPAR expression; breast SUVmean ~1.2 at 1 h (abstract value). FIH 68Ga-NOTA-AE105 (n=10 incl. 2 breast): safe, renal clearance, tumour visible.
background_organs: Kidneys/bladder (renal clearance); liver for 64Cu
notes: uPAR also on myeloid/stromal cells.

stage: Phase 3 (marginal zone lymphoma, LYMFOR NCT06125028, terminated for low enrolment 2025)
breast_tnbc_evidence: Prospective breast cohort (n=51, 18 TNBC): 49/51 visually positive; SUVmax 7.3 vs FDG 18.8; higher uptake in TNBC, high grade and Ki-67; detected more brain/skull mets than FDG, FDG better for skeletal mets.
background_organs: Spleen, bone marrow, kidneys/bladder, lymphoid tissue
notes: Uptake partly reflects immune/myeloid cells.

breast_tnbc_evidence: 18F-fluciclatide phase 1 in metastatic breast (n=7, 18 lesions): all CT lesions visible (liver mets photopenic). 18F-alfatide II vs FDG suspected breast cancer (n=44): sensitivity 88.1% vs 90.5%, combination raised sensitivity to 97.6%. No breast publication found for 68Ga-NOTA-PRGD2 (UNVERIFIED).
background_organs: Liver, kidneys/bladder, spleen, gut
notes: Signal mixes tumour cells and neovasculature.

breast_tnbc_evidence: [18F]avb6-BP FIH included metastatic breast patients (n of breast UNVERIFIED): uptake in primaries and brain/bone/liver/lung mets. 68Ga-trivehexin breast: single case report.
background_organs: Kidneys/bladder, stomach/GI mucosa (UNVERIFIED detail)
notes: Weak breast evidence.

breast_tnbc_evidence: No breast-specific human data. 68Ga-B7H3-BCH in 20 pts with mixed malignancies: diagnostic efficacy 85.0% vs 81.7% FDG; SUVmax 3.85 cutoff 84% sens/100% spec for B7H3. 89Zr-DS-5573a imaged MDA-MB-231 (TNBC) xenografts.
background_organs: Kidneys (affibody; UNVERIFIED detail)
theranostic_partner: 124I-omburtamab (convection-enhanced, DIPG phase 1; PMID 39969230); B7-H3 ADCs non-radioactive

stage: Phase 1-2 (head & neck, lung, colorectal); breast preclinical only
breast_tnbc_evidence: No human breast EGFR immunoPET found. 89Zr-cetuximab phase 1 (n=9 HNSCC/NSCLC) and mCRC (n=35): uptake did not predict cetuximab benefit. 89Zr-panitumumab improved HNSCC staging with FDG.
background_organs: Liver (high, target-mediated), skin, blood pool

breast_tnbc_evidence: 68Ga-RM2 pretreatment staging (n=15): all PET-positive tumours ER+; SUVmax ER+ 10.6 vs ER- 2.3. 68Ga-NeoB in ER/PR+ HER2- metastatic (n=20): 75% positive vs 65% FDG.
background_organs: Pancreas (very high), normal breast (moderate, variable), kidneys/bladder
notes: ER-linked; low expected relevance for TNBC.

breast_tnbc_evidence: Phase 2 Dotatate PET in ER+ breast cancer; TMA: 51% of ER+ vs 18% (22/121) of ER- tumours SSTR2+. One ER+ patient treated with 225Ac-DOTATATE.
background_organs: Spleen, kidneys, adrenals, pituitary, liver
notes: Low relevance for TNBC given ER- SSTR2 rate.

stage: Phase 3 completed (ZIRCON, ccRCC); FDA CRL Aug 2025 for CMC issues - not approved as of last web check
breast_tnbc_evidence: OPALESCENCE prospective pilot in mTNBC (n=12): 231/273 lesions detected vs 264 by FDG; overall sensitivity 87.5% (100% breast/skin/adrenal).
background_organs: Liver, blood pool (antibody), bowel/gastric mucosa (UNVERIFIED)
notes: Surprise: a TNBC-specific CA-IX immunoPET cohort exists.

stage: Preclinical (89Zr-transferrin); small human pilot of 68Ga-transferrin/citrate in prostate cancer (conference abstract only)
breast_tnbc_evidence: No breast human data found.
pmid_or_nct: UNVERIFIED (no PubMed record for human TFRC PET retrieved)
background_organs: Liver, bone marrow (iron metabolism), blood pool

breast_tnbc_evidence: No breast human data found. FIH in mRCC (n=12): 79% of 87 lesions c-MET-positive, median SUVmax 4.35.
background_organs: Kidneys/bladder, liver, spleen

breast_tnbc_evidence: No imaging agent found in PubMed or web search.
notes: Antibodies exist (therapeutic); basophil/mast-cell expression would be a background concern.

breast_tnbc_evidence: No imaging agent found (PubMed 0 hits).
notes: Intracellular nuclear protein - poor tracer target.

breast_tnbc_evidence: FLT is a partial CNT3 substrate but not selective.
No radiotracer found; only therapeutic inhibitors.
No radiotracer found; only therapeutic inhibitors (e.g., novobiocin, RP-6685, ART558). PARP1 tracers are the closest DNA-repair imaging analogue.
